content: Ɓa dǝgit marawa kǝ uudaha

Zaraabahara, akwama nǝghamanǝghǝg kǝ uuda ma haipa, kuuramǝn am ndzǝga ma Shiɗkwa Daadamazhigǝlna, am gwidan kǝ uuda nǝ iin dat ɗuula. Famfǝg kǝ hǝnkala, anabi dlaɓ dlakulva saa dǝ zarab dat ɗuula agha dǝm damma fishǝg biya.
Mǝlamarumǝlǝg kǝ zaraabaharu tǝdvad kǝsa dlaɗa kyalmaha. Am da righǝg ǝndkwan kǝ adzahadzaha Kristi.
Akwama tlatlǝgan nǝ uudan taakiya mǝng nǝ dǝgit tuuk vakai nǝ iina, mbats maay nǝ dǝgiti tuuk vakai nǝ iin biya, valaba ghǝraana.
Aa zharnazharǝg nǝ uudan kǝ tlǝrani ɓag nǝ iin ndana. Akwama ba marawa, lakwti da tiɗa fiɗavǝgh dǝ dǝgiti ɓagaa nǝ iin dǝ ghǝrana, bamma gǝra ghǝran dǝ uudi tlǝrn biya.
Aɗaba ɓagaɓag kǝ maraw aanji bawara akǝsǝg kǝ kadlanga ghǝraana.
Baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa tsagǝvaru nǝ ǝlbǝga Kristiya aa tagwnatagw kǝ dǝgaha harǝr baɗǝm dǝ daddakwa tsagarutsaga.
Valamndabi kǝ ghǝraru biya, ɓagabi marvara nǝ ɗyǝmɗyǝmǝr kǝ Daadamazhigǝl biya. Badǝm nǝ dǝgiti aa riiga nǝ uuda, iin wa da ghudǝg nǝ iina.
Aɗaba ma riyarig nǝ uudan dǝ naaga ǝrviɗmahuɗaana, da ghuɗǝgan kǝ ǝmtsǝga. Akwama aa riiga dǝ naaga shiɗkwa Daadamazhigǝla, da ghuɗǝgan kǝ shifǝga tangwa damma zǝrazǝra.
Mbakyarvad kwaha kuɗǝyamalbi dǝ ɓa dǝgit maraw biya. Aɗaba akwama kuɗǝyamalbi, kǝ ɓagan biya, da sagau nǝ sarta kwa kiyam da ghuɗǝg nǝ miyam kwa dǝ barka.
Mbakyarvad kwaha, ba kǝla sarti kiyam tlǝkǝna nǝ miyam kǝ ɗuula ɓagaana, mǝlamarumǝlǝg kǝ uudah baɗǝma, kyambar zaraabahamiyami kwama Krǝstiya.
Əlbǝga mbasuumbasa
Zharamzharǝg kǝ hulfa vinɗǝgahan dyakdyakǝn vindankura nai dǝ dǝvara.
Aiciya uudahanǝn ar na ba ma cingaba dǝgatǝr nǝ uudna, iitǝr wana fǝkura barari ɓakura nu uud kǝ aguvaca. Ar ɓakur kwana aɗaba ar gǝdza dlaɗǝn ar da huɓǝg nǝ iitǝr mbakyarvad hǝrtǝga Kǝristiya.
Aanji ba lii ɓagavtǝraɓag nǝ aguvac ndakwani ar maay tsuufa adzahadzaha Muus biya. Ar naa ba ma ɓakura nǝ uud kǝ aguvaca kiyava taakiya iitǝr wa fakura ɓakura nǝ uud kǝ aguvaca.

Kiyava kaiya ǝn maay tǝɗa fǝɗavǝgh biya, bamma tǝghǝr kǝ hǝrtǝga Yaazhigǝl Yesu Kǝristiya, Aɗaba tǝdvad ǝmtsǝgan tǝ tlaɓa hǝrtǝga nǝ wa ɗuuwanars nai kǝ ndzǝgana duniya, dlaɓa ǝmtsanaǝtsǝg kwakyarvad dǝga duniya.
Ɓagaɓagan nǝ aguvaca ɓagabi na aguvac biya maay nǝ dǝgiti tuuk vakai nǝ iini, dǝgit marawa kǝ uuda, aa nalnǝg kǝ daala vǝrɗǝgga.
Gagǝra ard zhuwaɗaala aa dzadzǝg tǝghǝr kǝ lii gata kwan kǝ ɗuul baɗǝmma, kwa yaa izraila ba jiijiira.
Cigǝt ndakwana da tǝvuuk zaraabahara, aa gwiyabi nǝ uudan kǝ gagyakai dǝ dǝgiti tlǝr biya, aɗaba vavǝrahan tǝ vǝgharna maradamarǝg taakiya ǝn ɛva Yesu naiya.
Aa ndzandzǝg nǝ harǝrra Yaazhigǝl Yesu Kǝristi ǝmtaɗ dǝ Shiɗkwaru zaraabahara. Amin.
